prompt: Yuto visited the cat cafe, and the orange cats were (sleepy) than he expected.
explanation_ru: У прилагательных на согласную + -y при добавлении -er буква y меняется на i: sleepy → sleepier.

prompt: Did the empty corner become the (pretty) spot on Andre's street after neighbours planted sunflowers?
explanation_ru: В превосходной степени у прилагательного на согласную + -y буква y меняется на i перед -est: pretty → prettiest.

prompt: My homemade pasta dough wasn't tricky; it rolled (easily) than I thought.
explanation_ru: Наречия на -ly образуют сравнительную степень с помощью more, а не суффикса -er: more easily.

prompt: Are real moon capsule seats really the (thin) seats in the whole space centre?
explanation_ru: В односложном слове с краткой гласной перед одной согласной эта согласная удваивается: thin → thinnest.

prompt: That black-and-white film about a grumpy bakery cat was the (funny) film at the festival.
explanation_ru: В превосходной степени прилагательного funny буква y переходит в i перед -est: funniest.

prompt: I didn't expect much, but this cheap pizza tasted (good) than any hotel meal.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное good имеет неправильную сравнительную степень better (не more good и не gooder).

prompt: Sinead's dentist finished the cleaning the (quickly) of anyone she had ever visited.
explanation_ru: Наречия на -ly образуют превосходную степень с помощью most: (the) most quickly.

prompt: Our video interview didn't end early; it lasted (long) and felt (relaxed) than Carlo had guessed.
explanation_ru: Короткое наречие long принимает -er (longer), а прилагательное-причастие relaxed образует степень через more (more relaxed).

prompt: Nobody believed Anja when she said the guest conductor spoke (warmly) and smiled (often) than their old teacher.
explanation_ru: Наречие на -ly (warmly) и двусложное наречие often образуют сравнительную степень с помощью more.

prompt: Is the sunny reading corner at Aria's school the (cosy) and (popular) room in the building?
explanation_ru: В слове cosy буква y меняется на i (cosiest), а многосложное popular требует most (most popular).

prompt: Under the dome, Saturn's glowing rings looked (close) and shone (clearly) than on any textbook page.
explanation_ru: К прилагательному на -e добавляется только -r (closer), а наречие на -ly образует сравнение через more (more clearly).

prompt: With the cool sea breeze behind me, I ran the final hill (fast) and felt (little) tired than on flat roads.
explanation_ru: Наречие fast не имеет окончания -ly и принимает -er (faster), а у little неправильная форма сравнения — less.

prompt: Why did the grandparents build the (simple) app and finish (early) than the teenage teams at Alyssa's club?
explanation_ru: Двусложное simple на -le обычно принимает -est (simplest), а у наречия early буква y меняется на i перед -er (earlier).

prompt: Even though we packed raincoats for grey drizzle, the week turned out to be the (dry) and (hot) stretch of the summer, so we walked far along the cliffs.
explanation_ru: В dry буква y переходит в i (driest), в hot удваивается t (hottest).

prompt: Because kitchen tiles turn icy at night, my dog sleeps (well) on this thick fleece mat and moves (freely) in the morning than he used to on thin blankets.
explanation_ru: У наречия well неправильная сравнительная степень better, а наречие на -ly (freely) требует more.

prompt: Whenever Solveig organises a rocky beach clean-up, woven canvas bags hold (much) rubbish and handle sharp shells (safely) than thin plastic sacks.
explanation_ru: Сравнительная степень от much — неправильная форма more, а наречие safely образует её через more safely.

prompt: Although midday tours pack the stone archway, Kostas insists that dawn is the (peaceful) time to visit and lets you hear the audio guide the (clearly) of the whole day.
explanation_ru: Прилагательные на -ful (peaceful) и наречия на -ly (clearly) образуют превосходную степень с помощью most.

prompt: Mathieu bought a cheap wooden wardrobe for his new flat. He thought the job would take one hour. Sadly, the doors were (heavy) than he thought, and the instructions were the (bad) he had ever seen. At nine o'clock, he ate soup on the floor.
explanation_ru: В heavy буква y меняется на i перед -er (heavier), а bad имеет неправильную превосходную степень worst.

prompt: Ivana booked a small hostel in Dubrovnik and feared a noisy room. Instead, the host gave her a shady stone terrace under green fig trees. Her room felt (cool) than the street below, and the guests spoke (quietly) than at any hotel she knew. It became the (pleasant) stop of her whole holiday.
explanation_ru: Односложное cool принимает -er (cooler), наречие quietly — more quietly, а двусложное pleasant обычно образует степень через most pleasant.

prompt: We expected glass cases and strict signs at the railway museum in Utrecht. Instead, our children climbed into shiny green carriages and pulled a real station bell. They behaved (well) than in any park, and my (old) son asked ten questions about steam engines. Even I didn't feel bored at all.
explanation_ru: Наречие well имеет форму better; говоря о старшем члене семьи перед существительным, используют elder (или older).

prompt: Jakub ordered a large frying pan online because the photos looked great. When he opened the parcel locker outside the supermarket, he burst out laughing. The pan was (tiny) than his breakfast mug and weighed (little) than a plastic spoon. He definitely won't trust those shop pictures again.
explanation_ru: У прилагательного tiny буква y переходит в i перед -er (tinier), а сравнительная степень от little — less.

prompt: Have you ever worried about getting lost in a huge underground station? Haruto felt nervous on his first morning in Kyoto. Luckily, bright coloured floor lines made transfers (easy) than he feared and got him to his platform (soon) than expected. The whole system runs the (smoothly) of any metro he has tried.
explanation_ru: В easy буква y меняется на i (easier), короткое наречие soon принимает -er (sooner), а наречие на -ly — most smoothly.

prompt: Hi Mum, my oral history exam in Uppsala was nothing like the nightmare I had imagined. The two examiners offered me herbal tea and laughed when my pencil rolled under the radiator. They asked (gentle) questions than my tutor in Lisbon, and I explained my ideas (confidently) than in our practice class. Honestly, it turned out to be the (good) exam of my entire university term.
explanation_ru: Двусложное gentle на -le обычно принимает -r (gentler), наречие confidently — more confidently, а good имеет форму best.

prompt: "I thought our new editor was going to ignore all the interns," Davide admitted over coffee. "So did I, because she looked like the (strict) manager on the third floor," his colleague replied. "Actually, she stayed late to fix my page layout and explained every change (patiently) than my previous boss. She even brought the (tasty) lemon biscuits I have ever eaten."
explanation_ru: Односложное strict принимает -est (strictest), наречие patiently — more patiently, а в tasty буква y меняется на i (tastiest).

prompt: If you want to enjoy the painted canal boats in Aveiro, skip sunny Sunday afternoons. Weekday morning rides are the (relaxing) way to glide through the (narrow) channels without bumping into other boats. Because there are (few) tourists on the dock, the guides also speak (slowly) and answer every question.
explanation_ru: Прилагательное relaxing требует most, narrow на -ow обычно принимает -est (narrowest), с исчисляемыми используют fewer, а с наречием на -ly — more slowly.

prompt: Notice to all college students: please use the new upstairs printer during essay week. The old basement machine jams (frequently) and prints (badly) than any other device in the building. Upstairs, your pages come out the (fast) and the ink looks the (sharp) on thick paper. Thank you for helping us avoid long queues.
explanation_ru: Наречие frequently требует more, у badly неправильная форма worse, а короткие fast и sharp образуют превосходную степень с -est.

prompt: Twenty friends in silver paper crowns gave Fabian the ___ surprise of his life.
explanation_ru: В односложном big согласная g удваивается перед -est (biggest). Типичная ошибка — писать most big или забывать удвоение.

prompt: Don't pay for priority boarding here; the free queue is moving ___ than ours!
explanation_ru: Наречие fast совпадает по форме с прилагательным и образует сравнительную степень с -er (faster), а не more fast или fastly.

prompt: Skip the cold starters because the warm cheese bread is ___ than anything else.
explanation_ru: Односложное cheap принимает -er без удвоения согласной (cheaper). Типичная ошибка — использовать more cheap.

prompt: After a whole rainy month of deliveries, Diego says these rubber boots kept his socks ___ than leather ones.
explanation_ru: В слове dry при добавлении -er буква y заменяется на i (drier). Двойное сравнение more drier и написание dryier неверны.

prompt: Lorenzo rides uphill ___ in his new vented helmet because it doesn't trap heat under the sun.
explanation_ru: После глагола rides нужно наречие comfortably, которое в сравнительной степени требует more: more comfortably (не прилагательное more comfortable).

prompt: Since the ferry dock is ___ from the office than the bus stop, would you really walk there every evening instead of taking the shuttle?
explanation_ru: У far неправильная сравнительная степень further (или farther). Формы farer и more far — типичные ошибки.

prompt: Silicone mats are more easy to clean than old metal biscuit trays.
answer: Silicone mats are easier to clean than old metal biscuit trays.
accepted_answers: Silicone mats are easier to clean than old metal biscuit trays.
explanation_ru: Двусложное easy оканчивается на -y, поэтому образует сравнительную степень через -ier (easier), а не more easy.

prompt: Getting his lost wallet back from the local police officer was the most good moment of Bruno's trip.
answer: Getting his lost wallet back from the local police officer was the best moment of Bruno's trip.
accepted_answers: Getting his lost wallet back from the local police officer was the best moment of Bruno's trip.
explanation_ru: У good неправильная превосходная степень — the best. Форма the most good является частой ошибкой.

prompt: Magnetic spice tins keep Linnea's tiny kitchen tidier than crowded cupboard shelves ever did.
answer: Magnetic spice tins keep Linnea's tiny kitchen tidier than crowded cupboard shelves ever did.
accepted_answers: Magnetic spice tins keep Linnea's tiny kitchen tidier than crowded cupboard shelves ever did.
explanation_ru: Предложение верно: у прилагательного tidy буква y правильно заменена на i перед -er (tidier).

prompt: Although this small family hotel in Sorrento is elder than the big resorts on the cliff, its quiet lemon garden feels far more welcoming.
answer: Although this small family hotel in Sorrento is older than the big resorts on the cliff, its quiet lemon garden feels far more welcoming.
accepted_answers: Although this small family hotel in Sorrento is older than the big resorts on the cliff, its quiet lemon garden feels far more welcoming.
explanation_ru: Форма elder употребляется только для людей (членов семьи) и никогда не ставится перед than; о зданиях и с than нужно older.

prompt: Nuria laughed at Palma Airport because the shiny express bag-drop belt worked more badly than the ordinary staffed desk next to it.
answer: Nuria laughed at Palma Airport because the shiny express bag-drop belt worked worse than the ordinary staffed desk next to it.
accepted_answers: Nuria laughed at Palma Airport because the shiny express bag-drop belt worked worse than the ordinary staffed desk next to it.
explanation_ru: Наречие badly имеет неправильную сравнительную степень worse, поэтому вариант more badly неверен.

prompt: Karim warns cinema guests that the rooftop gets cold after sunset. Which notice fits best?
options: Bring a jumper because the roof feels cooler after sunset.
Bring a jumper because the roof feels more coolly after sunset.
Bring a jumper because the roof feels the coolest after sunset.
Bring a jumper because the roof feels cooller after sunset.
explanation_ru: После глагола-связки feels нужно прилагательное cooler (в односложном cool согласная l не удваивается, и наречие не подходит).

prompt: Monica loved the string trio at her wedding because guests could still hear her grandfather's quiet speech. Which review matches this?
options: The trio played softlier than a big band, so everyone heard the speech.
The trio played more softly than a big band, so everyone heard the speech.
The trio played more soft than a big band, so everyone heard the speech.
The trio played softerly than a big band, so everyone heard the speech.
explanation_ru: Для описания действия played требуется наречие softly в сравнительной степени more softly; форм softlier и softerly не существует.

prompt: Margrit advises older learners to keep one password notebook at home instead of sticking yellow notes around the monitor. Which sentence expresses her advice accurately?
options: Keeping one notebook indoors is the most safe way to avoid losing your passwords.
Keeping one notebook indoors is much more safely than leaving loose notes by your screen.
Keeping one notebook indoors is far safer than leaving loose notes around your screen.
Keeping one notebook indoors is safeer than leaving loose notes beside your monitor.
explanation_ru: К односложному safe на -e добавляется только -r (safer). Варианты most safe, safeer и наречие safely после is неверны.

prompt: Our corner pharmacist is a more careful helper for elderly patients than the other staff. → Our corner pharmacist helps elderly patients …
answer: Our corner pharmacist helps elderly patients more carefully than the other staff.
accepted_answers: Our corner pharmacist helps elderly patients more carefully than the other staff.
explanation_ru: При переходе от существительного helper к глаголу helps прилагательное more careful заменяется наречием more carefully.

prompt: Every other school bag on the trip got wetter than Catriona's waterproof backpack. → Catriona's waterproof backpack stayed the …
answer: Catriona's waterproof backpack stayed the driest on the trip.
accepted_answers: Catriona's waterproof backpack stayed the driest on the trip.
Catriona's waterproof backpack stayed the driest school bag on the trip.
Catriona's waterproof backpack stayed the driest of all on the trip.
explanation_ru: Смысл «суше всех остальных» передаётся превосходной степенью от dry с заменой y на i: the driest.
